a,b=finite_difference_dynamics(cfg,1.,1e-7)
t=dimensionless_absolute_transform(12,StateScales(1.25,.15,.5,.75))
p,root,diag=high_precision_lyapunov_factor(a,b,gain,t,decimal_digits=80)

print(json.dumps(dict(diagnostics=diag,gain_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(gain)),max_P=float(np.max(abs(p))))))
